greeting: Egameni likaYise, neleNdodana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube nani uxolo nothando lukaThixo uYise, nalo uYesu Kristu iNkosi yethu.
penitential: Nkosi, sihawukele. Kristu, sihawukele. Nkosi, sihawukele.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendlela ende, apho amehlo ethu adiniweyo ajonga phezulu efuna impendulo esibhakabhakeni. Mhlawumbi uke wema ecaleni kwesango lebala leenqwelo-moya, ubukele iinqwelo-moya zisuka zinyuka ziye emafini, ucinga ngaloo mntu wayekuthanda ukubukela iinjini neempiko zazo zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo thando. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, engajongi nje iindiza, kodwa ejonga ubukhulu bukaThixo obufihlakeleyo kwiimfihlo zenzululwazi kunye nobuchwephesha. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuzibona iindiza zayo zibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu unyuka intaba ukuba aye kuthandaza. Uchitha ubusuku bonke ethandaza kuThixo. Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… UYesu, unyana kaThixo, uzimela kude ukuze athethe noYise. Ufuna ukulungiselela intliziyo yakhe ngaphambi kokuba akhethe abo aya kubathuma. UYesu akakhethi ngokungxama; ukhetha ngokuthandaza. Uphakathi kobusuku kwaye uYesu uyazi ukuba umsebenzi wakhe uya kufuna amadoda aya kuhlala naye, aya kuhamba naye, kwaye ekugqibeleni aya kufa naye. USimon noYuda—abapostile esibabhiyozelayo namhlanje—babenye yabo bafundi ababiziweyo. Babengengabo abantu abagqibeleleyo, kodwa babengabantu abavumayo ukulandela.

UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukulandela. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye. Khumbula lo mfanekiso: uBen, eneminyaka eli-15, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Ubenayo loo ntliziyo yayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukunika, owayethanda ukuba nomdla kwabanye, owayesoloko enoncumo olwaluthi, 'Ndikhona, ndiyakuthanda.' UBen wayengumfana owayewazi umthetho omkhulu kwaye wawuphila ngendlela yakhe ethuleyo kodwa enamandla.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usixelela ukuba thina 'asiyisiyo abafokazi.' Singamalungu endlu kaThixo. UBen ngoku usendlwini kaThixo. Uyakhiwa njengamatye aphilayo kunye noSimon noYuda, kunye nabo bonke abangcwele. UBen akalahlekanga kule ndlu; ukhuselekile. Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando esingapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngomoya nangothando lwakho. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba ukhona, kwaye ndizibophelela kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Sikelelwe uThixo, uYise, neNdodana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hamba ngoxolo, uthembe uthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abahambileyo, ukuze baphumle kukhanya lukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abazilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abanike ithemba eliqinileyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana, anisezizo iindwendwe nabahambi, kodwa ningabemi kunye nabangcwele, ningamalungu endlu kaThixo, eyakhiwe phezu kwesiseko sabapostile nabaprofeti, uKristu Yesu ngokwakhe engumtya wembombo. Ngaye isakhiwo sonke sibambene, sikhula sibe yitempile engcwele eNkosini; ngaye nani niyakhiwa kunye, nibe yindawo yokuhlala uThixo ngoMoya.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: Amazulu abalisa uzuko lukaThixo, isibhakabhaka sibhengeza umsebenzi wezandla zakhe. Imini iyaxelela imini ilizwi, ubusuku buyazisa ubusuku ulwazi. Akukho lizwi, akukho ntetho, elingaviwa ilizwi labo. Emhlabeni wonke ilizwi labo liyavakala, nakwimiphetho yelizwe imiyalezo yabo.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngaloo mihla, uYesu wenyuka intaba ukuba aye kuthandaza, wahlala ubusuku bonke ethandaza kuThixo. Kwathi kusa, wabiza abafundi bakhe, wanyula kubo abalishumi elinambini, abathi wababiza ngokuthi ngabapostile: uSimon, amthi nguPetros, noAndreya umninawa wakhe, uYakobi, uYohane, uFilipu, uBartholomeyu, uMateyu, uTomas, uYakobi ka-Alfeyu, uSimon obizwa ngokuba ngumZeloti, noYuda kaYakobi, noYuda Iskariyoti, owaba ngumngcatshi.

day: Feast of Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
